[bold #D75FFF]◆ EPIC bob-cli-on[/bold #D75FFF]
[dim]  Title: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]Task requirements (reqs)[/bold #D7AFFF]
[dim]   Goal: [#D7D7AF][/dim]A task can carry requirements: checkbox children without `#task`, [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]nested as deep as the work needs, drawn as a quiet ⌗⌗ run in the [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]task's ink. They are met when the task closes and can never be [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]ticked early. They can be dropped with a reason or carried into [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]their own task, and the close card audits them once. They sit in [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one canonical block order beside a NOTES drawer, and they promote [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]one level at a time into project tasks. bob-cli, bob-plugins, Bob [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]Mac Capture, and the vault agree byte for byte through shared [/#D7D7AF]
[dim]         [#D7D7AF][/dim]vectors, and every legacy REQUIREMENTS drawer becomes NOTES.[/#D7D7AF]
[dim] Counts: [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]17[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] phases[dim][/dim] · [bold #D7AFFF][/dim]7[dim][/bold #D7AFFF] waves[/dim]
